filter: Subset of 1575 cases (All cases of [L=20] (SHA-1), [L=28] (SHA-224), [L=32] (SHA-256), [L=48] (SHA-384), [L=64] (SHA-512) with Klen <= 256 bytes; tag is the truncated Mac of tlen bytes (leftmost bytes of the full HMAC).). Per hash and Klen: the first 4 cases with full-length tags (tlen = L) and the 2 cases with the shortest tlen (lowest Count first). Compare tag against the leftmost tlen bytes.
